subject: Fix memory leak in deferred reply buffer (#2615)
reason: The fix only adds a free method to the deferred reply list in initDeferredReplyBuffer(), which is created solely when a module has subscribed to keyspace notifications (moduleNotifyKeyspaceSubscribersCnt() > 0). No installed experiment loads a module, MODULE LOAD is refused in command sequences, and scenarios/experiments here may not declare module artifacts, so no runnable scenario can execute the changed line on either build. Even on the parent build the bug is a pure memory leak with byte-identical replies, data and topology, so a compared sequence would have no command that could correctly
